dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Refers to 1 kg of grass seed (rye grass) from intensive organic production with water content of 10% The dry matter content of dried grains is 0.9 kg/kg. The grains contain 1.55 kg CO2 and 17.87 MJ per kg DM seed.; UUID: 91ad53a6-0cbd-3efb-9631-11fc16e1e119

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Intensive organic production.

# Included processes
The inventories include the production of organic grass seed on a temporary meadow and its further processing and storage. Included steps are soil cultivation, fertilisation (cattle slurry and manure), harvest, transport, processing, drying and storage.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
